svg.title: Plain LLM test run vs. Satori quality checks
svg.desc: A 26-second loop on the web repo. Left: an assistant runs pnpm test:unit and all tests pass. Right, in five steps: Satori detects pnpm, TypeScript and Svelte and keeps the existing .satori.yml; recommends Lint, Format, Types, Unit and Security checks; finds 132 lint errors, 280 unformatted files and 21 dependency advisories while unit tests and types pass; catches an existing XSS check that never ran and replaces it with an unsafe_html rule that catches a planted file; and turns results into findings with a baseline so the next run flags only new failures. Closing title: Tests passing does not equal quality. Satori writes the playbook that checks the rest.

g.text: The eslint script doesn’t exist, so it always passed.
Next run flags only new failures.
Satori writes the playbook that checks the rest.
